learning_question.vi: Top đang chỉ điều gì, và điều đó làm thay đổi vùng live thế nào?

predict_prompt.en: Predict empty, full, read and write indices before revealing them.

normal_case.vi: Cùng capacity và cùng hai item logic: đặt cạnh snapshot next-free và current-top để so sánh top cùng vùng live.
normal_case.en: For the same capacity and two logical items, compare next-free and current-top snapshots, top values and live regions.

boundary_case.vi: So sánh state rỗng và đầy của cả hai quy ước; từ đó suy empty/full/read/write equations.
boundary_case.en: Compare empty and full states under both conventions, then derive empty/full/read/write equations.

failure_case.vi: Cố ý ghép top khởi tạo của một quy ước với live-range equation của quy ước kia để học sinh phát hiện mâu thuẫn.
failure_case.en: Deliberately combine one convention's initial top with the other's live-range equation so learners detect the contradiction.

representation_and_convention: next_free: empty=0, full=capacity
current_top: empty=-1, full=capacity-1

boundary_case.en: Run the one-free-slot case followed by the full case; the first commits one item and the second preserves all state.

learning_question.vi: Khi chỉ một Pop thành công, event nào phục hồi giao dịch?

boundary_case.en: Use all four cases: both success, left-only, right-only and both empty. One-sided cases restore exactly once; both-empty performs no restore and no mutation.

failure_case.en: Restore the wrong stack or Push a sentinel in both-empty; show the fabricated state and label any authored both-empty message AlgoCore_inference.

distinct mutable instances per required slot
record count and storage capacity follow the QP

full when count equals capacity

learning_question.vi: Một group line trở thành đúng một destination item ở event nào, và guard nào chặn read/commit tiếp theo?
learning_question.en: At which event does one line group become exactly one destination item, and which guard blocks the next read/commit?

state_to_show: An input-file lifecycle plus a record buffer, converted fields, destination array/record/ADT and committed-record count.
Every committed destination element corresponds to one complete source record in file order, committed_count never exceeds capacity, and no read occurs outside the open-file interval.

predict_prompt.vi: Dự đoán event kế tiếp và state nào phải được giữ nguyên.
predict_prompt.en: Predict the next event and which state must remain unchanged.

normal_case.vi: File gồm hai record, mỗi record hai line name/score: mỗi cặp phải tạo READ×2→CONVERT→COMMIT, count đi 0→1→2 rồi CLOSE.
normal_case.en: Use a file with two two-line name/score records: each pair must produce READ×2→CONVERT→COMMIT, count moves 0→1→2, then CLOSE.

boundary_case.vi: So EOF sau một record rưỡi, capacity đầy trước EOF và open failure; không path nào commit half-record hoặc vượt capacity, và error output đúng contract.
boundary_case.en: Compare EOF after one-and-a-half records, capacity full before EOF and open failure; no path commits a half-record or exceeds capacity, and error output follows the contract.

failure_case.vi: Commit field/array element trước khi đọc đủ mọi line của record.
failure_case.en: Committing a field/array element before all lines of the record have been read.

representation_and_convention: open before the first read and close on every required completion path
group all lines of one record before conversion/commit
EOF/fixed count and capacity are independent guards
exception output remains source-bound

learning_question.vi: Record buffer nào chọn constructor hoặc target object nào, và khi nào object state mới được commit?
learning_question.en: Which constructor or target object does the record buffer select, and when is object state committed?

state_to_show: A complete typed record buffer mapped to one object constructor/subclass or to one located existing object, followed by a single object commit/update.
Each successful record produces exactly one correctly typed source-permitted object creation or one update to the uniquely matched object; no partial object enters destination state.

predict_prompt.vi: Dự đoán event kế tiếp và state nào phải được giữ nguyên.

normal_case.vi: Một record bốn field description/width/height/colour phải buffer đủ, convert hai số, construct đúng parameter order và commit một object/count.
normal_case.en: A four-field description/width/height/colour record must buffer fully, convert two numbers, construct in exact parameter order and commit one object/count.

boundary_case.vi: Đối chiếu record subtype khác, lookup key không tồn tại và final record thiếu field; route/lookup phải rõ và không case thất bại nào tạo partial object.
boundary_case.en: Contrast a different subtype record, a missing lookup key and a final record missing one field; route/lookup must be explicit and no failure creates a partial object.

failure_case.vi: Đọc sai số line/record làm field record sau trượt sang record trước.
failure_case.en: Reading the wrong number of lines per record so a later field shifts into the previous record.

representation_and_convention: construct only after complete typed record parsing
subclass discriminator selects one source-permitted constructor
create and update paths have distinct postconditions
count increases only for created/stored objects

learning_question.vi: Open mode biến đổi pre-file state thế nào, và mỗi formatted line được commit theo order nào trước close?
learning_question.en: How does open mode transform pre-file state, and in what order is each formatted line committed before close?

state_to_show: An output-file lifecycle plus an ordered stream of formatted record lines derived from source state.
The emitted suffix contains exactly the source-selected records in required order and format; append preserves the prior prefix, while overwrite obeys the new-file contract.

predict_prompt.vi: Dự đoán event kế tiếp và state nào phải được giữ nguyên.
predict_prompt.en: Predict the next event and which state must remain unchanged.

normal_case.vi: Ghi ba record name/score vào output mới: mỗi record tạo một formatted line theo order, WRITE×3 rồi CLOSE; file cuối chỉ có ba record mới.
normal_case.en: Write three name/score records to a new output: each forms one ordered line, WRITE×3 then CLOSE; the final file contains only the three new records.

boundary_case.vi: Với pre-file có prefix sentinel, append phải giữ prefix còn overwrite phải bỏ; physical tree rows phải ra triples theo row dù inorder khác.
boundary_case.en: With a pre-file sentinel prefix, append must preserve it while overwrite removes it; physical tree rows must emit row triples even when inorder differs.

failure_case.vi: Dùng overwrite khi phải append hoặc append khi phải tạo output mới.
failure_case.en: Using overwrite when append is required, or append when a new output is required.

representation_and_convention: append preserves existing content; write/overwrite starts the source-required new output
field and newline grammar is source-bound
physical storage rows and logical traversal/order are distinct
close occurs after the final write or on the required handled path

learning_question.vi: Call nào đang sở hữu state version nào, và return nào mở khóa event kế tiếp?
learning_question.en: Which call owns which state version, and which return unlocks the next event?

state_to_show: A call-and-state graph whose nodes are orchestration steps and whose edges carry parameters, return values, state versions and branch outcomes.
After each orchestration event, every completed call has received the source-required arguments, its result/state version is owned once, and every pending call still has a satisfiable precondition.

predict_prompt.vi: Dự đoán event kế tiếp và state nào phải được giữ nguyên.
predict_prompt.en: Predict the next event and which state must remain unchanged.

normal_case.vi: Pipeline Read→Sort→Output dùng state v0→v1→v2: mỗi call chỉ mở khi producer trước hoàn tất và Output nhận đúng v2.
normal_case.en: A Read→Sort→Output pipeline uses state v0→v1→v2: each call unlocks only after its producer completes, and Output receives v2.

boundary_case.vi: So zero-iteration, one-iteration và failed-call result: không branch nào dùng stale result, không consumer nào chạy khi precondition chưa thỏa.
boundary_case.en: Compare zero-iteration, one-iteration and failed-call results: no branch uses a stale result and no consumer runs with an unsatisfied precondition.

failure_case.vi: Gọi output/search/transform trước producer hoặc dùng state version cũ.
failure_case.en: Calling output/search/transform before its producer or using a stale state version.

representation_and_convention: a dependency call is referenced rather than reimplemented
call order follows preconditions and state versions
each return is stored/used before dependent calls
loop count and result branch remain source-bound

normal_case.en: Render two records with distinct fields as two labelled lines; events must preserve exact literals, separators and order while leaving source state unchanged.

boundary_case.vi: Dùng backing rows có physical order khác inorder và một empty/unused slot; chọn đúng physical hoặc logical range phải cho first/last/count khác nhau theo contract.
boundary_case.en: Use backing rows whose physical order differs from inorder plus an empty/unused slot; selecting physical or logical range must produce the contract-specific first/last/count.

failure_case.en: Having correct values but missing a label/separator/newline or concatenating fields in the wrong order.

representation_and_convention: exact source literals and labels are preserved when specified
physical storage order is distinct from logical traversal/order
range can include unused physical slots
formatting does not mutate the underlying data structure

learning_question.en: Which input, observable and attribution must each planned capture show before Stage 6 can review it?

state_to_show: A Stage 5/6 evidence-capture plan linking each prescribed case to setup/reset, visible inputs, required output/file state and a named capture slot; no execution evidence exists yet.
Every planned capture is attributable to exactly one test case and shows all source-required observable evidence, while no Stage 4 field states that execution, output or screenshot already exists.

predict_prompt.en: Predict the next event and which state must remain unchanged.

normal_case.vi: Thiết kế hai capture slots cho hai prescribed runs: mỗi slot liệt kê reset, visible input, expected output và case id; cả hai vẫn PENDING Stage 5/6.
normal_case.en: Design two capture slots for two prescribed runs: each lists reset, visible input, expected output and case id; both remain PENDING Stage 5/6.

boundary_case.vi: File-evidence case yêu cầu filename và contents trong frame; một output-only crop phải bị capture gate từ chối và không được gọi là run/pass.
boundary_case.en: A file-evidence case requires filename and contents in frame; an output-only crop must fail the capture gate and must not be described as a run/pass.

failure_case.vi: Plan chỉ chụp output, thiếu prescribed input, case id, file contents hoặc filename bắt buộc.
failure_case.en: Planning an output-only capture that omits prescribed input, case id, file contents or a required filename.

representation_and_convention: Stage 4 designs evidence obligations but does not claim a run occurred
official prescribed cases are distinguished from AlgoCore-added coverage
each capture shows enough input/output/file identity to be attributable
multiple runs have explicit reset/state lineage
